title: under siege west bank 2026 09 12
text:
Follow on Apple or Spotify. Listen on the Reuters app.

As wars rage across the Middle East, another conflict is unfolding in the occupied West Bank. On this episode of On Assignment, Reuters correspondent Pesha Magid travels to the Palestinian village of Qusra, which has become the focal point of a growing struggle over land, security and political power.
